results.problem: Counting 3-colorings of generalized circular chord graphs
results.quote: We developed an optimized backtracking algorithm with memoization to count valid 3-colorings efficiently, reducing complexity from \(\mathcal{O}(3^n\cdot m)\) in brute-force enumeration to O(2.8^n), where m is the number of edges.

results.problem: Chromatic count P(C_n^(3),3) for odd n

results.quote: For \(n=2m\), there exists a finite matrix \(\widehat{A}\) of size at most 144 such that \(P(\mathcal{C}_{2m}^{(3)},3)=\mathrm{tr}(\widehat{A}^m).\)

results.problem: Positivity of P(C_n^(3),3) for odd n
results.bound: P(\mathcal{C}_n^{(3)},3) > 0 \text{ for all sufficiently large odd } n
results.quote: Consequently \(a(n)=\varphi^n+R_n\ge\varphi^n-C\rho^n>0\) for all odd \(n\ge N_0\). Hence \(a(n)>0\) for infinitely many n (indeed for all sufficiently large odd n), proving (ii).
